visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man in a white t-shirt sits at a desk cluttered with laptops in a dimly lit office. Suddenly, a woman in a brown jacket jumps out from behind him, and he reacts with a sharp, terrified facial expression, clutching his chest and jumping back in his chair. (2) The room brightens as the overhead lights come on. Two other women join them; one has short blonde hair and a purple top. They engage in an animated discussion, pointing at each other and the computer screens while laughing. (3) The lights begin to flicker rapidly. A man in a light blue shirt enters the frame from the left, looking startled. The entire group clusters together, their mouths open as if shouting in mock terror. (4) The group of about five people stands together in the center of the office. They appear to be arguing or teasing one another. Hand gestures are frequent, and facial expressions vary from fake anger to amusement as they talk. (5) A transition screen appears with a black background and white text that reads '一小時後'. (6) The whole group is now gathered in a larger assembly, most holding smartphones out as if recording a scene. They are smiling and looking towards the camera. A man in the center wears a light blue t-shirt and smiles broadly. (7) A final close-up shows a woman with very pale skin and straight, long black hair, wearing a white long-sleeved shirt. She stands against a plain wall next to a light switch panel, staring intensely at it with a blank, eerie expression while her hand rests on the switch.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A sudden, high-intensity percussive thud occurs, followed immediately by a sharp, high-pitched male scream with explosive high arousal. The background is studio-clean silence. (2) Multiple female voices enter, speaking in a fast-paced, animated tempo with a comedic and teasing tone. A mid-tempo, lighthearted piano-based BGM fades in. (3) Rapid, rhythmic mechanical clicks (simulating light switches) occur alongside a sudden increase in vocal volume and overlapping screams of fear from multiple people. (4) Sustained group chatter follows with multiple distinct voices, both male and female, in a fast speech rate with frequent interruptions and laughter. (5) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound effects a scene change, followed by a brief period of low-frequency ambient hum and a decrease in vocal activity. (6) A collective loud cheer ('Whoo!') with high arousal and positive valence erupts. The BGM swells in volume, and multiple people are heard laughing and talking excitedly. (7) The BGM cuts out abruptly. A series of rapid, rhythmic mechanical clicks (switch toggling) follow, ending in a single, final heavy click. Absolute silence follows the click.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Prank -> Argument -> Escalation -> Plot Twist
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic sketch produced by the group 'This Group of People' (這群人). It humorously depicts the escalation of office pranks during the 'Ghost Month' (鬼月), moving from simple jump scares to an eerie twist where an actual ghost-like figure appears, suggesting that some scares in the office aren't just pranks.
